summary: The change fixes the root cause of issue #2283: TypeCollector now skips compiler-generated fields (metadata auto-property backing fields such as <Key>k__BackingField, whose names are not valid C# identifiers) when enumerating members in both key and map mode, and every diagnostic location that indexed DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] now tolerates symbols without syntax via FirstOrDefault(), with a new GetIdentifierLocation that also handles record primary-constructor ParameterSyntax. On head all new generator and analyzer tests pass (full suite 203/203, no regressions versus base), while on base source 17 of the 31 new tests failed with IndexOutOfRangeException/AD0001 or InvalidCastException, so the fix covers REQ-2283-F1 through F3 and N1/N2. Two observations only: mutation coverage is thin for the new guards, and diagnostics for members of metadata-declared types may carry no location.

requirement_verdicts.confidence_basis: GeneratorProducesResolver passes for all referenced-library cases on head (including "struct generic") and GeneratorCollectsTypeArgumentOfReferencedGenericValueType passes with PayloadFormatter and global::Lib.Item<global::App.Payload> in the generated output; the same new tests failed on base source with IndexOutOfRangeException (the CS8785 path), and the fix filters metadata backing fields out of member enumeration (lines 753/1050) and stops indexing DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] (line 1077).

findings.title: Mutation coverage is thin for the new compiler-generated-field guard
findings.claim: Under the harness rule (only new tests count as kills), mutants at TypeCollector.cs:1050 (M2 negating the guard, M4 dropping it to if (true), M5 swapping || to &&) and at TypeCollector.cs:1455 (M3 making IsCompilerGeneratedField always return false) survived with no killing test; existing tests do fail on M2/M4, but no new test isolates the skipping of metadata auto-property backing fields.

evidence.quote: private static bool IsCompilerGeneratedField(ISymbol member) => member is IFieldSymbol { CanBeReferencedByName: false };

findings.suggested_fix: Add a regression test that observes a metadata auto-property backing field is skipped (for example, require all non-public members in the app and assert no MemberNeedsKey is produced for the imported backing field), or accept the gap: end-to-end tests already fail without the fix and existing tests fail on the guard-negating mutants.

findings.title: Diagnostics for members of metadata-declared types carry no location
findings.claim: When a member of a type from a referenced assembly lacks a key, MemberNeedsKey is created with item.DeclaringSyntaxReferences.FirstOrDefault()?.GetSyntax() resolving to null, so the diagnostic has no location in the user's compilation. This does not violate REQ-2283-F3 (no location outside the compilation), but the user cannot navigate to the member, and the behavior is only implicitly covered: AnalyzerDoesNotThrowOnInvalidReferencedType asserts no AD0001, not the absence of null-location diagnostics.
findings.suggested_fix: Decide whether to suppress MemberNeedsKey for metadata-declared members with no syntax, or document that such diagnostics have no location.
